title: BizCity Pipeline Stage Change
description: PHASE-0.52 R-PIPE-2/3, bumped to 2.0.0 in PHASE-0.63C GC-1 (R-WORK-PIPE-2/7): result of POST /crm-contacts/{id}/stage (B2) or /crm/pipeline/contacts/{id}/stage (C), and any future pipeline_kind that reuses this contract. Flexible: any manual stage incl. won without an order; only lost needs a reason (enforced server-side). Every change is audited; no customer PII in this DTO. 2.0.0 replaces the 8-value sales enum on from/to/stage with a free-form stage key so purchase/request/production kinds are not blocked by a sales-only contract (0.62 §3 mục 1); FE no longer pattern-matches a fixed STAGE_ORDER (R-WORK-PIPE-10), so this is additive risk only.

pipeline_kind.description: 2.0.0 — which pipeline definition this run belongs to (R-WORK-PIPE-2). 'sales' for every producer today.

subject_type.description: 2.0.0 — R-WORK-PIPE-7. Omitted/absent means 'contact', the default subject.

subject_id.description: 2.0.0 — id of the subject row (contact_id or project/account_id) when subject_type is present.

progress_pct.description: 2.0.0 — position of `stage` within the pipeline_kind's definition.stages[], 0-100. Null when the kind has no linear ordering to compute one from (e.g. a gated/parallel stage set).

gate_blocked.description: 2.0.0 — true when the requested transition was rejected because an AND gate in definition.gates[] is not yet satisfied (R-WORK-PIPE-2). Always false for kinds without gates.
